title: Ellen Kuzwayo's birth chart
metaDescription: Ellen Kuzwayo's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 6.8° Cancer. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Four of the ten placements whose signs are settled stand in Cancer — the Sun, Mercury, Neptune and Pluto. The placements whose signs could change with an unknown hour are not counted. A cluster that size becomes the section the rest of the chart plays around.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun sits at 6.8° Cancer — the first decan, 0°–10°, which the tradition sub-rules by the Moon. Degrees matter more than the sign label here: two people born a fortnight apart share Cancer and share almost nothing else about where the Sun actually stood.

blocks.title: The personal registers
blocks.text: Day to day the chart speaks through Mercury in Cancer (28.5°), Venus in Leo (11.0°), Mars in Virgo (1.9°): a mind that absorbs before it argues, taste that runs toward the vivid and the immediate, drive that grinds rather than flares.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Venus to Uranus is the closest call of the day, an opposition within 0.1°. An opposition is the tradition’s tug of war. Both ends are real, and the work is holding them at once rather than picking a winner. Behind it, Mars sextile Pluto at 1.1°, and Mercury conjunction Neptune at 1.4° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. These are the day-proof angles — present at midnight, present at noon, present at the next midnight.

blocks.title: The standing structure
blocks.text: The Moon stands apart from every major angle the day held — the tradition reads an unaspected planet as a voice that speaks on its own schedule, unmodulated by the rest of the chart.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: No planet here is at home, exalted, in detriment, or in fall. That silence from the oldest layer of the scheme is itself a result, and it moves the weight of the reading onto the geometry.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: The certain ground: 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, dividing 4 water, 3 air, 2 earth, 1 fire by element and 4 cardinal, 3 mutable, 3 fixed by mode. Water signs hold memory in the scheme, where nothing is quite finished and little is genuinely forgotten. Jupiter and Uranus were retrograde — motion that reverses only from this vantage point, and which the old reading treats as delay used for revision.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Virgo for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 13.9° between midnight and midnight. The sign survives the missing hour; the degree does not, and is given as a reference rather than a fact. At the noon reference it stands at 18.6°.
